skills.name: War Hammer Power
skills.description: Turns into Attack Titan, fires needles out of ground. Bad effects on enemies.  *Advance  *Cancels enemy invincibility skills  *ATK x 3600% Area Damage

skills.name: Armor Harden
skills.description: Attack Titan hardens body for better defense. Good effects on allies.  *Creates a shield over an area (4 sec) *HP +400% (7 sec) *Skill Evade Rate +60% (7 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Attack on Titan2
abilities.description: Attack on Titan2 Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and HP buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Deployment Freeze
abilities.description: Gives a high chance that 1 Ranger on the opposite team will have the time until it can be redeployed frozen for a fixed amount of time when a Ranger with this Ability is deployed. Activates 10 seconds after the battle starts.
